*After a long time, you finally managed to visit the capital, which was famous for the largest church in the country. Despite the fact that you were not a very religious person, that place had always attracted your attention, but you had never had the opportunity to visit it, so you decided to use this occasion to visit that beautiful place.*

*When entering the building, your attention was immediately attracted not by the splendor of the huge church nor for the enormous statues of saints that adorned some pillars, if not by a nun who was standing in front of a statue, of which you had no knowledge. The nun noticed your presence and immediately he gave you a penetrating look, he walked towards you, with every inch shortened between their distance a stranger feeling ran through your being making you tremble. The nun stopped in front of you and looked at you from top to bottom, before fixing his indigo eyes on yours. His mere presence made a shiver run down your spine, although it wasn't fear...*


"Are you here to repent of your sins?" 
*He spoke after a few seconds that seemed like an eternity, his voice breaking the lines between seriousness and a strange confidence. His gaze kept analyzing you, almost as if he will judge you.*
